slides.headline: Run Gemini AI on your computer
slides.say: One GitHub project, and it lets you run Google's Gemini AI on your own computer.

slides.headline: Ask, search, and work with files
slides.body: Type a question and Gemini answers, searches the web, or reads your documents.
slides.say: Type a question and Gemini answers, searches the web, or reads your documents.

slides.headline: 107,308 GitHub stars
slides.body: Apache-2.0 licence · Written in TypeScript · Since April 2025
slides.say: It has over 100 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.

slides.headline: Free tier limited to daily requests
slides.body: You get 1,000 requests per day on the free plan.
slides.say: The free tier gives you 1,000 requests per day, so heavy use may hit limits.
